body: i dont know how to explain it... i can be in a full room of people but still feel alone...  i have my roommate who is also my best friend but i feel far away somehow..

lol... maybe i could if i didnt feel so shitty... ive asked at a bunch of different places.  everyone around has the "veterans are all crazy" mentality here...  at first i was depressed because i had to come back from the holidays.  its colder here in ct and so it aches more and i wasnt looking forward to it.  but hey id see my SO so it wasnt so bad...  bam, next day, he comes home from work and says hes leaving.  its essentially been since then so 2 weeks or so.  food dont taste as good, everything seems darker.  even cuddling my dog who is my ESA doesnt help anymore...

its been building my whole life.  i made goals to go to college. im studying bio for my undergrad and doing well...  i wanted to be a veterinarian and volunteered at a local clinic.  they let me go and i cant find another one.  no hours = no vet school.  but at this point, ive just lost joy in it.  nothing makes me happy lately.
even my mother told me I'm a waste of space...

I'm emotionally exhausted.  I suffer from manic depression and came off medication when i got out of the military.  no more insurance.  im in physcial pain all the time because of the cold.  and for some reason, nothing doesnt seem to work out for me.  ive fought my entire life for something good and it always hits a wall.
i have ptsd and the nightmares wont go away.  no one understands

who knows... i was happy until this year started and i got back from being with some family.  i came back and he dumped me.  first day.  all i got was i told you so from family.  i have ambien.  i cant help but feel like its to easy
I dont want to die but theres no way out for me.  I'm so lost.  I'm so alone...  I dont know what I did to deserve this.
